messages:
Ivy Chen: Heads up, OrbitalPay Accounting asked whether to submit a W-8 or a W-9 for invoice 22314 and flagged a gross-up clause in their contract. AP needs tax/legal guidance before release.

OrbitalPay Accounting: Hi Redwood, OrbitalPay here. We're a US-registered LLC (Delaware) but 75% owned by a Canadian parent. Which IRS form should we upload? Also our SOW includes a clause that Redwood will "gross-up" payments for any withholding. Portal link: https://pay.orbital.io/inv/22314

Marco (AP): Tagging @Rita (Tax) and @Legal Ops. AP can't clear invoice 22314 without the correct tax form on file. No TIN shown on the PDF.

Rita (Tax): Short checklist: 1) If they are US tax resident (EIN present and taxed in the US) -> W-9. 2) If they claim foreign status -> W-8BEN-E + proof of foreign tax residence and FATCA docs if needed. Foreign ownership alone doesn't change US tax residency for an LLC.

Legal Ops: On gross-up: our standard position is we do not accept automatic gross-up unless negotiated and approved. If the SOW was countersigned with that language we need to see execution evidence and get Commercial/Legal sign-off.

Ivy Chen: Placed payment hold in AP system. Asking vendor to upload signed W-9 with EIN and attach the executed SOW page that contains the gross-up language.

invoice-bot: Invoice 22314 status -> ON_HOLD. Reason: missing tax form and gross-up clause pending legal review.

OrbitalPay Accounting: Uploaded W-9 and provided EIN: 22-3334445. Attached SOW page with clause: "Client shall gross-up any payments to ensure Supplier receives the full amount net of withholding."

Rita (Tax): I'll validate EIN. If W-9 is valid we treat as US payee  no withholding. If they later submit W-8 we will need to evaluate treaty relief (US-Canada treaty) and proper supporting docs.

Legal Ops: I see the SOW was countersigned but I'm not seeing Commercial approval for gross-up. I'll escalate to Commercial to confirm whether this was intentionally accepted. For now, do not release payment on the basis of that clause alone.

Marco (AP): Noted, hold remains. AP note: "Awaiting W-9 validation + Legal/Commercial decision on gross-up."

Rita (Tax): EIN validated via TIN match. Tax classification: US payee. Recommendation: release payment once Commercial confirms they are okay not honoring gross-up or approves cost impact. From tax side no withholding or gross-up required.

OrbitalPay Accounting: Thanks, we'll wait for your update. If Commercial requires an amendment we can review redline.

Ivy Chen: Thanks everyone. Action items: Legal to confirm with Commercial on gross-up exposure, AP to release after confirmation, Tax marked vendor as US payee. Closing loop when payment completes. :white_check_mark:
